open.admin: Viewing tip: our lead is standing in the middle of a gate zone without an umbrella. A bold opening.
open.narration: You stop at the end of a wet alley. Sirens bleed in from somewhere far off, and the convenience store sign flickers, half dead. "Where am I?" The answer comes from your feet: a squeak. A sewer rat is studying your shoelaces with great seriousness.

Head deeper into the alley (success chance 35%)
Run for it

roll.admin: Was that an attack or a dance routine? Lucky for you, the rat held back its applause.

post.title: [BREAKING] Surprise C-rank gate opens on the Hwagok General Hospital lot
post.author: eastside_9
post.body: Around 11:48 the sky just tore open over the parking lot. Purple rift, you can see it with your own eyes. You can hear the hospital PA from outside. Word is every window in the first-floor lobby blew out. The Association's west branch is on the way but it'll take 15+ minutes. There are patients and a nursery in there. Please let everyone be okay.

hero1.admin: Viewing tip: a twelve-year-old is about to haggle with a licensed hunter. I've cancelled my other plans.
hero1.narration:
The gate over Mangwon station hums like a fridge left open. Under the flickering convenience store sign, a hunter in a long coat wipes her rapier with one hand and counts monster cores with the other.
[[Mira]]
"You're the kid selling maps of the sewer gates?" She doesn't look up. "Show me one that's real and I'll pay double. Show me a fake and you're bait."
hero1.speaker: Mira
choices: Unfold the map you drew last night (success chance 55%)
Raise the price before showing anything (success chance 30%)
Ask what she is hunting

relations.name: Mira
relations.note: A licensed hunter. Pays well, threatens better

quests.title: The Real Map
quests.note: Show Mira a real sewer gate map

hero2.admin: Twenty-three. The dice like you today. Don't get used to it.
hero2.narration:
You unfold the map against the shutter. Mira's eyes follow your pencil line down the storm drain, past the pumping station, to the X you drew in red.

She goes quiet. Then she laughs, short and surprised.

"C-3. Nobody has logged that entrance." She presses two cores and a folded bill into your hand. "Stay off the street tonight. Word travels."
hero2.title: Sewer Cartographer
choices: Count the money in the alley
Follow Mira at a distance (success chance 40%)
Go home and draw more maps
